boundary: Stage 27J is bounded late-layer output-side component attribution for Pythia-160M semantic likelihood margins. It is not complete circuit discovery, not model-wide control, not weight editing, and not visible free-form generation control.

carrier_cover.policy: Random controls use same layer/kind replacements when available. For singleton MLP blocks, the fallback preserves kind across candidate layers; if that is impossible, the report marks an unmatched fallback.
